# Golden regions of the 64 MiB FAT32 EFI System Partition (p2) of
# ws2022-win-server-01-install.img -- an image that booted on real Oxide hardware,
# installed Windows Server 2022 unattended, and came up with networking and RDP.
#
# Produced by src/lib/fat32.js. Extracted with:
#   dd if=<image> bs=512 skip=12584960 count=131072 of=p2.bin
#
# Every region here is independent of the three EFI binaries the volume carries:
# the boot sector and FSInfo depend only on geometry, and the directory clusters
# and FAT head depend only on names, sizes and cluster numbers. That is what lets
# fat32.rs check itself without the gitignored payload downloads.
#
# The timestamps read 2019-12-31 19:00:00. That is not a typo: fat32.js encodes
# new Date(Date.UTC(2020, 0, 1)) with local-time getters, so it stamped the
# builder host's US/Eastern rendering of midnight UTC. See fat32.rs::Timestamp.
#
# <name> <hex>
